brief:
Israel intends to construct approximately one thousand new settler housing units in the West Bank, Shehab Wire reported. The planned expansion would represent a significant addition to the existing network of settlements across the occupied territory and comes amid ongoing tensions over settlement activity in Palestinian areas.

The announcement underscores the continuation of Israel's settlement policy in the West Bank, a practice that has drawn repeated international criticism and remains a core point of contention in Israeli-Palestinian disputes over land and territorial control.
